$comment: Services section developer config: the three category tabs and the card-stack fanning offsets. Not editable copy. `tabs[].id` MUST match a top-level key in src/data/content/services.json — that is how a tab finds its cards. `color`/`glow` are forwarded to the stylesheet. `cardOffsets` positions the fanned stack behind the front card (index 0 = front, 3 = furthest back) and is consumed directly by framer-motion.
